stem.text: What is the electrons in boxes notation for the $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ ion?

A.alt: Column labels '3d' (above the five boxes) and '4s' (above the single box) are printed above the first row and apply to all options. Electrons in boxes after [Ar]. 3d: first box paired electrons, second box one electron, three empty boxes. 4s: one box with paired electrons.

B.alt: Electrons in boxes after [Ar]. 3d: three boxes with one electron each, two empty boxes. 4s: one box with paired electrons.

C.alt: Electrons in boxes after [Ar]. 3d: first box paired electrons, next three boxes one electron each, last box empty. 4s: empty box.

D.alt: Electrons in boxes after [Ar]. 3d: five boxes with one electron each. 4s: empty box.
